worst_case: A wrong definition is published under the office's name and misleads users of one series
controls_in_place: Curator approval of every draft; description check in the release procedure

worst_case: Users do not find a series that exists and turn to a secondary source
controls_in_place: Keyword search stays beside semantic search; retrieval scores on the question set each release

worst_case: Systematic miscoding of an occupation group changes published employment by occupation for a quarter
controls_in_place: Confidence threshold; re-coded sample each round; agreement by major group reported in the statement of model use

worst_case: An editor accepts a wrong explanation and imputes a wrong value in a confidential record
controls_in_place: Editors decide every case; proposals checked against the rules; sample audit

worst_case: A wrong figure in the commentary of a release reaches the press
controls_in_place: Every number verified by script against the tables; analyst approval; second provider tested

worst_case: The assistant states a wrong figure to the public with the office's citation
controls_in_place: Answers only from retrieved values; every number verified; monthly review sample; switch-off within one hour
